templates.template: Oracle Cloud Egress Monthly by HTTP
templates.name: Oracle Cloud Egress Monthly by HTTP
templates.description:
Monitors monthly outbound network egress (NetworksBytesOut) for an OCI Compute instance.
Alerts when approaching or exceeding the 10 TB/month Always Free limit.

Requires the same OCI API credentials as the other Oracle Cloud by HTTP templates.
Apply this template to the same host as Oracle Cloud Compute by HTTP.

items.name: OCI: Egress mensal (bytes)
items.description: Total de bytes de saída (NetworksBytesOut) acumulados no mês corrente.

items.name: OCI: Get monthly egress data
items.description:
Queries OCI Monitoring API for the month-to-date total of NetworksBytesOut.
NetworksBytesOut is a cumulative counter; .rate() gives bytes/second per day,
which is multiplied by 86400 to obtain daily bytes, then summed for the month.
Returns JSON: {"bytes": <total>, "pct": <percent_of_limit>, "remaining_bytes": <remaining>}.

items.name: OCI: Egress mensal (%)
items.description: Percentual do limite mensal de egresso utilizado ({$OCI.EGRESS.LIMIT.TB} TB).

triggers.expression: last(/Oracle Cloud Egress Monthly by HTTP/oci.egress.monthly.pct) >= {$OCI.EGRESS.WARN.PCT}
triggers.name: OCI Egress: Uso mensal de egresso alto (>= {$OCI.EGRESS.WARN.PCT}%)
triggers.event_name: OCI Egress: Uso mensal de egresso alto ({ITEM.LASTVALUE1} de {$OCI.EGRESS.LIMIT.TB} TB)
triggers.description: O egresso mensal da instância OCI ultrapassou {$OCI.EGRESS.WARN.PCT}% do limite de {$OCI.EGRESS.LIMIT.TB} TB do Free Tier.

dependencies.name: OCI Egress: Uso mensal de egresso crítico (>= {$OCI.EGRESS.HIGH.PCT}%)
dependencies.expression: last(/Oracle Cloud Egress Monthly by HTTP/oci.egress.monthly.pct) >= {$OCI.EGRESS.HIGH.PCT}

triggers.expression: last(/Oracle Cloud Egress Monthly by HTTP/oci.egress.monthly.pct) >= {$OCI.EGRESS.HIGH.PCT}
triggers.name: OCI Egress: Uso mensal de egresso crítico (>= {$OCI.EGRESS.HIGH.PCT}%)
triggers.event_name: OCI Egress: Uso mensal de egresso crítico ({ITEM.LASTVALUE1} de {$OCI.EGRESS.LIMIT.TB} TB)
triggers.description: O egresso mensal da instância OCI ultrapassou {$OCI.EGRESS.HIGH.PCT}% do limite de {$OCI.EGRESS.LIMIT.TB} TB do Free Tier. Risco de cobranças.

dependencies.name: OCI Egress: Uso mensal de egresso em nível de desastre (>= {$OCI.EGRESS.DISASTER.PCT}%)
dependencies.expression: last(/Oracle Cloud Egress Monthly by HTTP/oci.egress.monthly.pct) >= {$OCI.EGRESS.DISASTER.PCT}

triggers.expression: last(/Oracle Cloud Egress Monthly by HTTP/oci.egress.monthly.pct) >= {$OCI.EGRESS.DISASTER.PCT}
triggers.name: OCI Egress: Uso mensal de egresso em nível de desastre (>= {$OCI.EGRESS.DISASTER.PCT}%)
triggers.event_name: OCI Egress: Uso mensal de egresso em nível de desastre ({ITEM.LASTVALUE1} de {$OCI.EGRESS.LIMIT.TB} TB)
triggers.description: O egresso mensal da instância OCI ultrapassou {$OCI.EGRESS.DISASTER.PCT}% do limite de {$OCI.EGRESS.LIMIT.TB} TB. Cobranças adicionais são iminentes.

items.name: OCI: Egress mensal restante
items.description: Bytes restantes do limite mensal de egresso ({$OCI.EGRESS.LIMIT.TB} TB) para o mês corrente.
